stories.title: Two CPSC Recalls to Know This Weekend — Peony Design Bibs and Bellabu Bear Robes

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
Two active CPSC recalls for COS parents this weekend. 🚨

Peony Design bibs: snap can detach -- choking hazard. Sold on Etsy, Oct 2025-Jul 2026. Full refund.

Bellabu Bear kids' robes: burn hazard. Stop using now.

#COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting
